## When to use

Ecosystem tab label; use Kerf TabBar or SegmentedControl.

- Ecosystem tab label; prefer Kerf TabBar or SegmentedControl.

**Not when:**

- Do not use it in Kerf UI; use TabBar for application tabs or SegmentedControl for compact local views.
